There was no Common category before this. The ~50 seeded categories are MJ's own connectors

fields.Name: Common
fields.Description: Actions belonging to BizApps Common. Common.SyncActivities is the hourly activity-sync trigger; downstream apps register extensions rather than wrapping this.

_comments: THE OFFBOARDING HOLDINGS REGISTRY. Every app that holds a person's open responsibility (deals,
accounts, task and approval assignments, approver settings) ships its offboarding actions in this
category, and the Offboarding screen and the deactivation warning run every active action here.
Apps reference it with "CategoryID": "@lookup:MJ: Action Categories.Name=Offboarding Holdings",
so this row must be released before any app's actions. The contract (parameter names, the
Holdings and Skipped JSON shapes) is documented in packages/Entities/src/offboarding-holdings.ts.
primaryKey from uuidgen so a re-push updates this row rather than adding a second one.

fields.Name: Offboarding Holdings
fields.Description: Actions that list and reassign what a departed user or employee still holds. Each app ships '<App>: List Offboarding Holdings' and, where it can move items, '<App>: Reassign Offboarding Holdings'. Common's Offboarding screen and its deactivation warning run every active action in this category.
